notes: Modified cash basis village (basis cash). Governmental = Total Governmental Funds column p4; beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balance (includes certificates of deposit, restricted cash, county treasurer cash). Taxes 641,100 (p4) split using the p2 general receipts (property 425,162 + sales and use 167,413 + motor vehicle 29,519 + occupation 1,000 + special assessment 18,006 = 641,100). Intergovernmental 135,429 has no breakdown in the trimmed PDF. Governmental roll-forward: 1,101,599 + 1,647,172 - 1,180,327 + 166,635 - 254,563 = 1,480,516. Business-type = Water and Sewer, Total column p6, measure cash; no single printed total, so receipts = operating 422,832 + interest 44, disbursements = operating 130,372 + loan payments 8,679 + capital projects 303,062 (= p2 442,113); roll-forward 373,754 + 422,876 - 442,113 + 87,928 = 442,445. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the p3 governmental funds Balance Sheet Total column (equals p1 governmental 1,480,516), business-type from p1; totals 1,922,961 from p1. Detail: the p7 budget schedule gives only fund-level totals (budget only as grand total), so per-fund lines come from the p4 and p6 fund statement columns; the p6 nonoperating lines are under a separate 'nonoperating' schedule name with no detail_totals (only a net nonoperating total is printed). Per-fund Taxes stay taxes (unlabeled): the p2 breakdown is not by fund. Transfer cross-check: governmental in 166,635 (Street 42,316, Cemetery 10,324, Other 113,995) vs out 254,563 (General 173,609, Debt Service 76,010, Fire 4,944); net -87,928 equals the business-type operating transfers in 87,928 (Water 85,868, Sewer 2,060). No hidden transfers. Read pages 1-7 of 7
